name: Single Cell Atlas of Human Ocular Surface scRNA-seq: Cornea, Limbus, Sclera
description: This atlas is an integrated collection of over 815k cells, derived from single-cell RNA-seq data of human ocular surface, including cornea, limbus, and anterior sclera. These cells have been categorized into 10 major cell classes and 31 types.

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: This atlas is an integrated collection of over 815k cells, derived from single-cell RNA-seq data of human ocular surface, including cornea, limbus, and anterior sclera. These cells have been categorized into 10 major cell classes and 31 types. This is the initial cell type label for the atlas annotation. These labels will be examined, refined, and updated during the annotation jamboree.

labels.name: Limbus/Sclera Fibroblasts - C2
labels.rationale: 98.8% StC from Shi dataset; majorclass annotated by DCN; low expression of KERA

labels.name: Limbus_Epi-C2
labels.rationale: 50.9% LEpC from Shi dataset; majorclass annotated by KRT5, lower expression of KRT12 compared to Epi-PMC cluster

labels.name: Limbus_Epi-C1
labels.rationale: 47.3% LEpC from Shi dataset; 51.1% LPC from Chen dataset; majorclass annotated by KRT5, lower expression of KRT15 compared to LPC cluster

labels.name: Pericytes
labels.rationale: 99.0% PeC from Shi dataset; 98.7% fibroblastic corneal endothelial cells from Lako adult dataset;79.0% myofibroblasts from Lako fetal dataset; majorclass annotated by RGS5, ACTA2, low expression of DES

labels.name: CC_VenEndo
labels.rationale: 83% VEnC from Shi dataset;88.5% blood vessels from Lako adult dataset;58.7% lymphatic vessels from Lako fetal dataset;98.1% LSC from Chen dataset; majorclass annotated by PECAM1

labels.name: Lymphatic Endothelium
labels.rationale: 96.9% LEnC from Shi dataset; 100% lymphatic vessels from Lako adult dataset; 44.8% blood vessels from Lako fetal dataset; majorclass annotated by PECAM1, celltype annotated by CCL21

labels.name: Schwann_N
labels.rationale: 86.7% ScC from Shi dataset; 89.5% corneal endothelium from Lako adult dataset; 20.7% corneal endothelium + 79.7% corneal nerves from Lako fetal dataset; celltype annotated by SCN7A, NRXN1

labels.name: Epi-TDC
labels.rationale: majorclass annotated by KRT5; from Epi-PMC, Epi-TDC/PMC, to Epi-TDC, KRT3 and KRT12 expression increase; 11.8% conjunctival basal epithelium+98.7% corneal basal epithelium+99.1% corneal superficial epithelium+99.5% corneal suprabasal epithelial cells+99.5% limbal superficial epithelium+94.7% limbal suprabasal epithelial cells from Lako adult dataset; 26.1% Conj+88.5% TDC from Chen dataset

labels.name: Epi-PMC
labels.rationale: majorclass annotated by KRT5; from Epi-PMC, Epi-TDC/PMC, to Epi-TDC, KRT3 and KRT12 expression increase; 82.2% limbal neural crest progenitors from Lako adult dataset;59.7% corneal epithelium+59.4% limbal stem/progenitor cells+58.6% proliferating epithelial progenitors from Lako fetal dataset;99.4% PMC+64.5% TAC from Chen dataset

labels.name: Epi-TDC/PMC
labels.rationale: all from chen_cornea and chen_limbus, show the status between PMC and TDC; majorclass annotated by KRT5; from Epi-PMC, Epi-TDC/PMC, to Epi-TDC, KRT3 and KRT12 expression increase

labels.name: Monocytes
labels.rationale: 3.7% ImC from Shi dataset; majorclass annotated by PTPRD, celltype annotated by S100A8, S100A9

labels.name: Melanocytes
labels.rationale: 94% MeC from Shi dataset;35.6% melanocytes from Lako adult dataset;97.6% melanocytes from Lako fetal dataset;96.1% MC from Chen dataset; ; majorclass annotated by MLANA

labels.name: Macrophages
labels.rationale: 46.8% ImC from Shi dataset;61.1% immune cells from Lako adult dataset;28% immune cells from Lako fetal dataset; majorclass annotated by PTPRD, celltype annotated by C1QA, C1QB

labels.name: Corneal Stromal Keratocytes
labels.rationale: 100% corneal stroma keratocytes+99.6% corneal stromal stem cells+18.1% limbal fibroblasts from Lako adult dataset; 30.7% corneal endothelium from Lako fetal dataset; majorclass annotated by DCN, high expression of KERA

labels.name: Vascular Endothelium
labels.rationale: 15.8% VEnC from Shi dataset;9.1% blood vessels from Lako adult dataset;16.4% lymphatic vessels from Lako fetal dataset; ; majorclass annotated by PECAM1, celltype annotated by HEY1

labels.name: NK/T Cells
labels.rationale: 38.9% ImC from Shi dataset;29% immune cells from Lako adult dataset;18.2% immune cells from Lako fetal dataset; majorclass annotated by PTPRD, celltype annotated by KLRB1, CD7, CD2, IL32

labels.name: Mast Cells
labels.rationale: 4.9% ImC from Shi dataset;0.6% immune cells from Lako adult dataset;15.3% immune cells from Lako fetal dataset;; majorclass annotated by PTPRD, celltype annotated by KIT, CPA3

labels.name: Limbus/Sclera Fibroblasts - C1
labels.rationale: 81.1% limbal fibroblasts+100% limbal stroma keratocytes from Lako adult dataset;84.5% fibroblasts I+96.2% fibroblasts II+70% fibroblasts III+68% Limbal stroma+19% myofibroblasts+60% proliferating cells+97.1% proliferating corneal endothelium+11.4% proliferating progenitors+47.9% blood vessels+11.4% red blood cells from Lako fetal dataset; majorclass annotated by DCN; lower expression of KERA

labels.name: LPC
labels.rationale: 81.5% limbal progenitor cells+50.8% melanocytes from Lako adult dataset;9.1% corneal epithelium from Lako fetal dataset;34.8% LPC from Chen dataset; majorclass annotated by KRT5, high expression of KRT15

labels.name: Unknown Epithelium
labels.rationale: 22.8% conjunctival epithelium+17.1% corneal epithelium+23.5% limbal stem/progenitor cells from Lako fetal dataset; majorclass annotated by KRT5; not sure whether we should keep this cluster since it has relatively-lower nCount_RNA and nFeature_RNA

labels.name: Fetal_Epi/LSC/LPC
labels.rationale: majorclass annotated by KRT5; all from fetal multiome dataset from Chen lab; a relative-higher expression of MT-genes, not sure whether we should keep this cluster

labels.name: Unknown-DCN+
labels.rationale: 1.8% ImC from Shi dataset;3.1% immune cells from Lako adult dataset;29.6% immune cells from Lako fetal dataset; majorclass annotated by PTPRD, celltype highly expresses DCN, maybe doublets

labels.name: Schwann_M
labels.rationale: 9.8% ScC from Shi dataset; celltype annotated by MPZ, MBP

labels.name: Fetal Keratocytes
labels.rationale: 99.8% corneal stroma keratocytes I+98.2% corneal stroma keratocytes II+99.7% corneal stroma keratocytes III+35.2% endothelial progenitors+15.3% fibroblasts I+29.6% fibroblasts III+99.3% keratocytes I+99.6% keratocytes II+99.8% keratocytes III+99.4% keratocytes IV+31.7% Limbal stroma+89.8% neural crest+18.9% proliferating cells+27.1% proliferating epithelial progenitors+80.8% proliferating progenitors+92.5% proliferating progenitors I+97.5% proliferating progenitors II+98.4% proliferating progenitors III+82.9% red blood cells+100% ciliary margin from Lako fetal dataset

labels.name: Conj-Epi
labels.rationale: 87% conjunctival basal epithelium+97.3% conjunctival superficial epithelium from Lako adult dataset; 66.6% conjunctival epithelium from Lako fetal dataset; 57.7% Conj from Chen dataset; majorclass annotated by KRT5

labels.name: Fetal Fibroblasts
labels.rationale: 33.9% endothelial progenitors+97.4% limbal fibroblasts+77% mesoderm+10.1% proliferating cells from Lako fetal dataset; majorclass annotated by DCN; mainly from chen_fetal and lako_fetal datasets

labels.name: B Cells
labels.rationale: majorclass annotated by PTPRD; celltype annotated by marker gene IGHM, CD79A

labels.name: Schlemm Endothelium
labels.rationale: 19.7% lymphatic vessels from Lako fetal dataset; majorclass annotated by PECAM1, celltype annotated by PLAT, FN1

labels.name: Smooth Muscle Cells
labels.rationale: mainly from sclera samples; by marker genes ACTA2, DES

labels.name: Corneal Endothelium
labels.rationale: from cornea endothelium samples of Dickman dataset; by marker gene POU6F2, SLC4A11

labels.name: Fetal Endothelium and Endothelial Progenitors
labels.rationale: mainly from chen_fetal and lako fetal datasets; 41.8% corneal endothelium+23.7% endothelial progenitors+99.8% fibroblastic corneal endothelial cells from Lako fetal dataset; unsure majorclass
